subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read texts about ancient civilisations for main ideas and details.
Learn words like trade, agriculture, monument and empire.
Use subheadings, dates and synonyms to understand a text.

tf.s: Trade is the buying and selling of goods.
tf.why: Yes, that is the meaning of trade.
Correct, agriculture is growing crops and raising animals.

tf.s: A monument is a building to remember a person or an event.
'Not Given' means the statement is false.
tf.why: 'Not Given' means the text has no information about it.

tf.s: A subheading is a short title for a paragraph.
tf.why: Well done, it sums up the paragraph.

tf.s: Magan is mentioned in Sumerian records.
tf.why: Correct, this shows contact between the two.
With BC dates, the bigger number is earlier, so 3000 BC comes first.
They are opposites; 'ancient' means very old.

tf.s: Trade only allowed people to exchange goods, never ideas.
tf.why: Trade helped people exchange goods and ideas.
Correct, this fact was in the texts.

mcq.q: What does the map on page 38 show?
o: six ancient civilisations with their names, locations and dates
mcq.why: The map helps you place each civilisation.

mcq.q: What does 'Not Given' mean in a T / F / NG task?
o: The text has no information about it.
The text is missing a page.

mcq.q: Complete: ______ is the buying and selling of goods.
mcq.why: Trade is about goods and markets.

mcq.q: Put these in order from earliest: 30 BC, 3000 BC, 800 BC
mcq.why: With BC dates, larger numbers are earlier.

mcq.q: A paragraph describes farms, crops and water channels. Which subheading fits best?
mcq.why: Farms and crops are about agriculture.

mcq.q: What evidence shows that ancient Magan had contact with other civilisations?
o: Magan is mentioned in Sumerian records.
mcq.why: Being written about by the Sumerians shows contact.

mcq.q: How did trade help ancient societies?
o: It allowed the exchange of goods and ideas and developed the economy.
mcq.why: Trade connects people and grows the economy.

mcq.q: Why do time references like dates help you sequence a text?
o: They show the order in which events happened.
They show who wrote the text.
mcq.why: Dates tell us what came first.
